one_liner: A programmatic advertising API (Marketing API) used to create, manage, and extract insights from Meta ad campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, and Messenger.
access_notes: Developers can create a free Meta for Developers account and obtain development-mode credentials instantly, though production use on client accounts requires App Review and Business Verification.
verdict_reason: Meta provides fully self-serve developer access with official documentation, standard OAuth/token authentication, and an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.
Every Marketing API call requires an access token as a parameter.
The entry point is Meta for Developers. You need an existing Facebook account to create a developer account — free and instant.
The ads MCP server is a Meta-hosted Model Context Protocol server that lets you manage Meta ads directly from an AI agent.
